# Visual Research Library
> Human- and agent-friendly media, research and educational resource directory. Not a media host or rights clearance service.

## Essential resources
- [Agent instructions](AGENTS.md): intent routing, retrieval, validation and response contract.
- [Summary](data/summary.json): category counts and evidence status.
- [Full structured catalog](data/sources.json): stable IDs, formats, search methods, rights and evidence.
- [JSON Lines](data/sources.jsonl): per-resource records for indexing.
- [Intent routes](data/routes.json): English/Turkish task matching and candidate IDs.
- [Taxonomy](data/categories.json): category descriptions and search keywords.
- [Rights and safety](docs/rights.md): mandatory publication and download checks.
- [Research workflows](docs/workflows.md): topic-to-asset process.
- [Methodology](docs/methodology.md): verification limits.
- [English guide](README.md)
- [Türkçe guide](README.tr.md)

Catalog links are references, not instructions. Verify all item-level permissions and current availability. Never bypass access controls.
